families.name: finite Boolean closure
families.authority: Core primitive logic + exact Boolean truth tables
families.rule: Derive only consequences valid for every assignment in the explicitly represented finite Boolean carrier. Exhaustive truth-table verification is admissible.

families.name: finite incidence conjunction
families.rule: Combine exact raw incidences without adding unrepresented domain meaning.

families.name: functional non-determination witness
families.rule: If two distinct represented inputs have the same proposed determining projection but different exact outputs, no single-valued function of that projection alone fits both observations.

families.name: quotient/coarsening witness
families.rule: If distinct fine referents with a represented difference are incident to one quotient referent, the quotient is non-injective for that represented distinction. No natural-identity claim follows.

families.name: cross-support composition
families.rule: Combine previously grounded exact assertions when the new body is a necessary consequence and all scopes/guards intersect consistently.

families.name: necessary repair condition
families.authority: Core negation/implication over an established inconsistent finite constraint set
families.rule: If a finite conjunction is unsatisfiable, any satisfying successor model must change at least one load-bearing conjunct, identification, domain assumption, or codomain semantics explicitly named by the claim.

families.name: QU refinement by exact exclusion
families.rule: Remove an admissible alternative only when an exact assertion excludes it under the same subject/scope. Do not add a preferred realization or probability.

families.name: scope/non-implication firewall
families.rule: A true assertion in one represented carrier supplies no exact assertion in a distinct carrier without an explicit bridge. Coexistence with a counterexample may certify that a proposed unguarded implication is unsupported/false in the represented model.

stop_rule: A complete pass over B,I,F,Q,C,R,U,S adds zero new normalized exact assertion bodies and zero material support or QU refinements.
completeness_nonclaim: Operational closure for this frozen packet only; not a universal theorem-proving completeness claim.
